Interesting question about #DEI in #Research:

Say you are organising a mini-conference with symposia of 4 people each and you have to rate symposia proposals. All other things being equal, you want to encourage the more "diverse" symposia.
Say you have to choose between 3 equally-good proposals:
1. has 4 men
2. has 4 women
3. has 2 men and 2 women

(no other diversity-related information is provided)
**Which one should get the highest "diversity score"?** Sources to support your choice are welcome!

PS: I am not defining "diversity" because its definition is part of the question
